title: Greenwald FOIA finds UFO references in Obama-era records

tellings.quote: >> see the John Greenwald thing where he filed a FOIA and he got information back which indicated, I can't remember if it's 3,000 or 30, I think it might have been 30,000 references in Obama's documents in his presidency to like UFOs, UAP, AATIP, ATIP, etc.

plain: A researcher named John Greenewald Jr. filed a request under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, and got back material showing many references to UFOs in the records of Barack Obama's presidency, from 2009 to 2017. A researcher named Jason Simosa recalls this from memory: he can't remember if it was 3,000 or 30,000, but thinks it was 30,000 mentions of UFOs, UAP (the government's term for unidentified aerial objects), and AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports. If true, it would mean the subject came up often at the highest level of government.
